note: World-watch state for Binge's virtual role-org MVP. Committed (not in .claude/state, which is gitignored). cadenceDays maps the cadence label to a due-interval. snapshot holds the last-seen marker per source so /world-watch can diff and emit only deltas. lastScan null = never scanned = due. See docs/org/world-watch/DESIGN.md.

Firestore Security Rules language changes affecting what the ~787-line ruleset / hasOnly can express
reCAPTCHA Enterprise / App Check changes (site-key, provider init, API-key auth)
Dependabot alert/grouping changes affecting how advisories reach the repo
